Let\'s go
Welcome to DiAuto for MG4

Wireless Android Auto on your MG4\'s screen. Once your phone is paired with the car over Bluetooth, it joins the car\'s Wi-Fi hotspot and Android Auto starts by itself.\n\nThe next steps show the three gestures that work over Android Auto.
Two fingers from the left edge
Put two fingers near the left edge of the screen and slide them to the right. A menu opens with two large buttons: Disconnect and Settings.\n\nTap anywhere else to close it.
Two fingers from the right edge
Put two fingers near the right edge and slide them to the left to show or hide the car\'s bars and use the whole screen.
Two fingers from the top edge
Put two fingers at the top of the screen and slide them down to go back to the car\'s launcher. Android Auto stays connected.
Three fingers down
Slide three fingers down the screen to disconnect Android Auto and come back to DiAuto\'s home screen.
Good to know

• Google Maps becomes a trip planner: it gets your MG4's battery, consumption and charging power, and picks the charging stops.
• Settings → Car: your MG4 version, battery capacity and health, detected automatically and adjustable.
• Automatic battery preheating before a charging stop planned by Maps. Off by default, turn it on in Settings → Car.
• DiAuto installs as an update of the car's own Android Auto (AllGo). To go back to it: Settings → About → Go back, then restart the screen by holding the Home button for 20 s.
• Settings → About: show this tutorial again.
